mdr: undefined: insufficient degrees of freedom (n=1, p_cov=1, df=-3)

dependence.treatment: no cap heuristic; shared screens OR incomplete screen IDs => precision not established

policy.proposed: prioritize components with larger |L| (greater paired-format lability) for confirmation
policy.status: PROPOSED HYPOTHESIS pending justification: Lock-S evidence is across genes; transfer to prioritization across components for one gene is unestablished

variable_registration.L: atlas/v4 paired_observations delta_a_minus_b, format axis (Dome - Plastic Chronos, medium held)
variable_registration.B: score_b (Plastic reference-condition Chronos) from the same paired row
variable_registration.Y_direction: Chronos gene effect: more negative = stronger dependency (atlas field dictionary: Chronos scores; Lock-S convention)

cohort_record.selection_rule: ascending ModelID per component, then ascending eligible ScreenID (sgen012 audit detail)

failed_requirement: precision (MDR undefined: insufficient degrees of freedom (n=1, p_cov=1, df=-3) vs 0.146 at n=1; dependence shared=False; missing_screen_ids=0); policy feasibility (no documented confirmation-assay availability; direction unjustified)
resource_needed: additional INDEPENDENT measurement resource: paired-format L/B on >=367 matched independent components for one qualified endpoint (current atlas: 250 covered endpoints, max 1 component(s) each), PLUS endpoint bridge adjudication, source-dependence treatment, documented confirmation-assay availability, and a justified outcome-blind priority direction
